capabilities: Set attachment root path, folder, and filename with variables like ${notepath}, ${notename}, and ${date}
Override global attachment settings for individual files or folders, resolved by nearest match
Give specific file extensions their own location and naming rules via special cases
Auto-rename attachments on paste, drop, and note or folder renames, updating links
Rearrange linked attachments to their configured paths, splitting shared files when notes disagree
extras: The Rearrange linked attachments commands are explicitly marked experimental and the README advises backing up files before using them. Known issues include delayed link updates on canvas paste/drop and case-sensitivity errors during rearrange. Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese).
intentEvidence: This plugin is a further development of trganda/obsidian-attachment-management
problem: Obsidian's built-in attachment folder setting is a single global choice and cannot apply different locations or naming rules per note, folder, or file extension.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a further development of trganda/obsidian-attachment-management

summary: Attachment location manager that controls where pasted or dropped files are saved per note or folder, with variable-based naming and link rearranging.
